methodology.latency_scope: Warm in-process CPU and local filesystem; filesystem caches uncontrolled; no IDE or model inference latency.
methodology.routing_scope: 90 authored scenarios, no held-out set. Category labels are scenario context, not an independent oracle for underspecified/boundary requests.
methodology.quality_scope: Integrity and deterministic routing only. No complete agent-generated artifact quality scores or creator comparisons.
